transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we finalize the duty roster for the three uncovered exercise shifts — Tuesday 0600-1400, Wednesday 1400-2200, and Thursday 2200-0600 — I need to confirm a few things. Per our standing Monday personnel-sync routine, I need the company commanders and S-1 officer to report any roster changes before I publish the schedule. Alpha, Bravo, and the battalion support staff will each provide one team, and no team covers more than one shift. Once we have assignments settled, I'll need a named shift handoff for every assignment before I sign the final roster. Let's hear from each of you on who you're putting forward and any changes I need to be aware of.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Alpha Company's only currently qualified exercise-cell supervisor is Sgt. Ellis, and he is available only for the Tuesday 0600-1400 shift. He begins an instructor course Tuesday afternoon. I confirmed the course enrollment this morning, but the updated availability is not yet on the battalion roster.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Bravo Company's designated cell team must cover the Wednesday 1400-2200 shift. Our communications liaison is scheduled for a certification appointment Thursday morning and cannot support the Thursday overnight handoff. I received the appointment confirmation yesterday, but it hasn't been added to the exercise staffing worksheet yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to report a roster change this morning. I received a signed higher-headquarters personnel directive today requiring the battalion support staff team to cover the Thursday 2200-0600 shift, with the handoff logged to the duty officer. This directive has not yet been posted to the published roster.
transcript.speaker: A4
